messages:
Maya: Quick design check for the private setup preflight UI: thinking of an "impact bar" at the top that lists the 3 highest-impact issues with 1-line fixes and a small chevron to expand logs. Figma mock incoming: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW_UI_EXAMPLE

Devon: +1 to surfacing only the top issues. Suggestion: show an explicit label (Fail/Warning/OK) next to each item so color isn't the only signal. Make the primary action obvious (Expand vs Retry).

Alex: Backend note: current probe output is a plain log. For this we'll need structured checks: check_id, severity, impact_rank, short_title, quick_fix, raw_log_url, kb_slug, overall_status. I can draft the API contract if we agree fields.

ops-bot: Preflight run: 2026-06-03T09:02:11Z — 27 checks: 2 critical, 4 warning, 21 ok. Raw logs: https://internal/preflight/2212345678/log.txt. Fields currently: stdout, stderr, exit_code.

Keisha: Microcopy attempt: header: "Preflight finished — 27 checks: 2 issues" Bar item: "Registry unreachable — Quick fix: allow outbound HTTPS (443)" For mobile shorten to "Registry unreachable — Fix: allow 443". Avoid infra jargon like 'egress' in primary UI copy.

Jamal: Accessibility: please include the textual status (Fail/Warning/OK) and not rely only on color. Use aria-live="polite" to announce completion and aria-controls/aria-expanded on the chevron. When expanded, move focus to the log heading and provide a skip link back to the impact bar. Don't hide content with display:none for screen readers.

Maya: UX decision: show a one-sentence "Why this matters" inline only for critical items to limit clutter; link to KB for others. Also include a tiny copy icon on the bar that copies the 1-line fix; in expanded view show "Copy full diagnostic".

Devon: Feature-flag the inline explanation and collapsed-logs-by-default so we can A/B test support reduction vs clutter. Also ensure the copy toast is accessible and persistent long enough for SRs to read.

Alex: Timeline: I'll post a draft API contract today with the fields above plus a run_id for tracing. Frontend can implement the collapsed behavior behind flags. Keisha/Jamal — can you review copy + a11y once Maya updates Figma?

Keisha: Yes, I'll prepare compact and explanatory microcopy variants and map the top 15 error codes to KB slugs. Will avoid jargon and keep fixes action-oriented.

Jamal: One more a11y nit: for incremental progress updates while the probe runs, use aria-busy on the summary container and update a polite live region with progress (e.g., "Checking network... 12 of 27"). That helps screen reader users track progress.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll update the Figma with the impact bar, inline critical helpers, copy icon placement, and keyboard flows. Posting the new link by EOD and scheduling a 15m sync for sign-off. :thumbsup:
